title: Hearty Russian Sweet Potato Parfait
description: A creamy, sweet and savory parfait layering roasted sweet potato, yogurt, and golden yellow corn masa for a post-workout treat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss sweet potato cubes with butter, salt, pepper, and cinnamon, spread on sheet, and roast for 25 minutes until tender.
Whisk Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla, and a pinch of salt together in a bowl.
In a small saucepan, combine yellow corn masa flour with water, whisk until smooth, and simmer over medium heat until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir roasted sweet potato cubes into the thickened masa mixture and let cool slightly.
Layer the parfait by first adding a spoonful of the yogurt mixture at the bottom of each serving glass.
Add a layer of the sweet potato and masa mixture on top of the yogurt.
Sprinkle roasted chickpeas over the sweet potato layer for crunch.
Repeat the yogurt and sweet potato layers until glasses are filled, finishing with a top layer of yogurt.
Garnish each parfait with fresh mint leaves and serve immediately.
